scope: SM three-dimensional unitary left charged current. Coherent generalized rank-one phase gates with arbitrary physical direction and site-independent path gains. The separate tree test uses the historical F(1) lower bound 0.8 of round 1381 only for a coarse |Vcb| upper bound. Marginal rectangles have no assigned joint confidence. MZ and 1e16 are the same measurements transported under SM matching.
